verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a memory platform with pipelines and data-source integrations, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow trigger. The documented pipelines and integrations (remember, improve, GitHub/Linear indexing) are one-off or on-demand actions, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
